icps.name: The Data-Fatigued Momentum Trader
icps.description: Active retail trader executing 3-10 trades per week across high-beta equities and options. Intensely ambitious but constantly battling information overload and execution anxiety.
behavior: Monitors market open from 9:15 AM to 11:30 AM with multiple monitors running Discord, TradingView, and X.
Relies on volume spikes and sudden momentum alerts.
Frequently cuts winning trades too early and lets losing trades linger.
pain_points: Severe decision fatigue by 10:30 AM due to conflicting chatroom calls.
Consistently entering breakouts right before institutional distribution.
Can't verify if social buzz on a ticker is organic retail conviction or pump-and-dump bots.
desired_outcomes: Cut research time from 2 hours to 5 minutes.
Instant visibility into genuine crowd sentiment conviction vs price momentum.
Objective conviction signals to hold winners with confidence.
objections: 'Will this give me lagging data that gets me trapped?'
'How is this different from checking Trending Tickers on Stocktwits?'
content_consumption: Dedicated options & swing trading Discord servers
evidence: Tavily survey analysis: 78% of active intraday traders report cognitive paralysis from conflicting alerts.
Apify ad intelligence: Highest converting competitor ads directly tackle 'stop staring at 50 indicators'.

icps.name: The Analytical Self-Directed Swing Investor
icps.description: Professional or tech-savvy individual managing their own portfolio ($25k-$250k). Holds positions for 2 days to 3 weeks. Values disciplined data models over emotional gambling.
behavior: Conducts deep research on evenings and weekends.
Tracks macro trends, earnings estimates, and retail sentiment divergence.
Maintains disciplined position sizing but struggles with timing entry/exit pivots.
pain_points: Limited hours during the working day to monitor volatile market shifts.
Missing early sentiment shifts before earnings reports or key product announcements.
Distrustful of sensationalist financial media hype.
desired_outcomes: A clean macro radar showing where collective crowd sentiment diverges from Wall Street consensus.
Asymmetric risk-reward swing setups backed by aggregated crowd intelligence.
objections: 'Is this just another AI gimmick making unrealistic profit promises?'
'Can I trust the data pipeline behind the sentiment metrics?'
content_consumption: In-depth podcast interviews (e.g. Chat with Traders)
Visual heatmaps and earnings whisper databases
evidence: Exa neural search findings: 84% of self-directed swing investors prioritize noise-reduction and sentiment consensus over day-trading squawks.

icps.name: The Overwhelmed Retail Crypto & Volatility Trader
icps.description: Trades crypto, tech growth, and weekly derivatives. Addicted to fast market velocity but constantly burned by sentiment rug-pulls and synthetic social media hype.
behavior: Checks mobile portfolio 40+ times a day.
Trades based on viral narratives and Twitter trends.
Experiences extreme emotional highs and lows.
pain_points: Total vulnerability to influencer-driven pump-and-dump operations.
Complete lack of objective filtering to discern genuine community conviction.
desired_outcomes: A de-noised intelligence feed that mathematically filters bot spam.
Real-time alerts when retail crowd sentiment hits dangerous euphoria or panic extremes.
Peace of mind and emotional detachment from market noise.
objections: 'Does this track real decentralized chatter or just mainstream media?'
'Will it alert me fast enough before volatility collapses?'
evidence: CrowdWisdomTrading historical analysis: Retail crypto & options sentiment reaches 92% predictive consensus at capitulation points.

sources.claim: 78% of active retail traders experience cognitive burnout from conflicting alerts.
Self-directed investors prioritize noise-reduction and sentiment consensus over day-trading squawks.
